headline: Extends the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom, an independent federal panel, so it can keep operating through 2028.
what_it_does: This law renews the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom through 2028. Before this law, the commission was set to expire on December 11, 2026. The commission is an independent federal body that tracks religious freedom conditions in other countries, reviews U.S. government policy on the issue, and makes policy recommendations.

who_it_affects.group: The U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The commission can keep operating through 2028 instead of shutting down in December 2026.

who_it_affects.group: Congress, the President, and the State Department
who_it_affects.how: They will continue to receive the commission's monitoring reports and policy recommendations on religious freedom abroad.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted November 3, 2026; extends the commission past its prior December 11, 2026 end date through 2028.
